entries.text: Guided live demo of the Build orchestrator (demo-run@1): a start overlay (Continue, Pause between steps, Stop), then a scripted tour against throwaway demo-* builds: queue, launch, steps crossed off one at a time, a deliberate crash caught by the watchdog and retried, red CI with an auto-fix, merge-
